property_summary: Only the smartfix_owner (original deployer) can successfully call sudicideAnyone() without reverting; the buggy tautology allows any caller to execute selfdestruct, so the property 'the caller must be smartfix_owner or the call reverts' holds for the reference but fails for the mutant.
change_summary: Replace require condition with a tautology (e.g., 1==1), allowing anyone to trigger selfdestruct.
